capabilities: Sync the vault bidirectionally with a server-side manifest using 3-way diffing
Preserve both versions of a file as a conflict copy when two devices edit the same file
Guard against bulk deletions and server resets with confirmation dialogs and recovery options
Trigger syncs automatically on startup, quit, and debounced vault changes
Manage SSH connections with password or key auth, host-key pinning, and encrypted secrets
extras: Not yet available in the Obsidian community plugin store (listed as coming soon); install from source or GitHub releases. Desktop only — mobile Obsidian cannot open raw SSH sockets. No end-to-end encryption of file content; files are stored as-is on the server. README documents detailed troubleshooting and recovery scenarios.
intentEvidence: You want multi-device sync without paying for Obsidian Sync.
problem: Obsidian Sync is a paid service and cloud drives (Dropbox, Google Drive, iCloud) don't offer transparent, self-hosted sync for users who already run their own SSH server.

relations.evidence: You want multi-device sync without paying for Obsidian Sync.
Use Obsidian Sync or an OS-level sync (Syncthing) for mobile.
You don't want Dropbox / Google Drive / iCloud touching your notes.

requires.name: an SSH/SFTP server (own server, VPS, NAS, or home machine)

summary: Bidirectional vault sync over the user's own SSH/SFTP server, with 3-way diffing, conflict-copy resolution, and bulk-delete protection.
